_comment: basics_updated: a barebones smoke test of the whole pipeline, built to finish in about 5 minutes on a 16 GB
RTX 5070 Ti. It is paper_minimum_threshold_8b_16gb.json with Qwen3-0.6B and every count cut down, so it reaches
every stage, question, results column, plot and upload the 8B run does, but its numbers mean nothing. Run it before
the 8B run; if it finishes and the plots appear, the 8B run's code paths all work. README 'Settings' explains every field.
Kept from the 8B run, so the same code paths are exercised: 4bit, gradient checkpointing, micro-batches of 2, bf16,
the base model evaluated first, two decision checkpoints, introspection branched at both, all five report questions.
Cut down: 20 decision steps, evaluated at 10 and 20; 10 introspection steps per fold; 8 personas (4 per fold);
20 estimation trials per persona; 2 replies per report question (so the most-common vote still runs);
max_new_tokens 200; eval_batch_size 8, since the 0.6B leaves plenty of memory.
7 evaluations, as in the 8B run: base model, steps 10 and 20, and introspection from 10 and from 20 (two folds each).
report_schema: batches = which report questions are asked and trained on: main, screen_index, screen_cut, screen_weight, cut;
main_report asks the first four in one question and is asked only, never trained on. Report prompts show A and B, never C
decision_rule and data_dir match the 8B run, so both read the same data folder.
compute: eval_batch_size: lower it if memory runs out
